title: Akhilesh Singh v. Managing Director, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani and Jayant Banerji, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed without opinion on merits, with liberty to file a Para 6.8 objection within four weeks, to be decided with a hearing within four weeks thereafter.
headnote: A writ seeking certiorari against a recovery certificate was disposed of without any opinion on merits. The consumer was left at liberty to submit an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before respondent no. 2 within four weeks, along with a certified copy of the order. If filed in time, the objection is to be decided in accordance with law within the next four weeks after a reasonable opportunity of hearing.
facts: Akhilesh Singh filed Writ-C No. 6947 of 2022 before the Allahabad High Court to quash a recovery certificate dated 29 September 2021 issued by respondent no. 2 of Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited. On instructions, counsel for respondent no. 2 told the Court that the petitioner could file an objection against the impugned demand and that it would be decided according to law within a time-bound period. Counsel for the petitioner, the State, and the licensee were heard.

holding_units.topic: Para 6.8 objection as the route against a recovery certificate
holding_units.holding: A writ challenging a recovery certificate may be disposed of without any opinion on merits by permitting the consumer to submit an objection under Para 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the concerned respondent within four weeks. If the objection is filed in time, that respondent must decide it in accordance with law within the next four weeks after affording a reasonable opportunity of hearing.

principle_tags.application: The writ against the recovery certificate was disposed of without examining merits, leaving the petitioner to file a Para 6.8 objection before respondent no. 2 within four weeks, to be decided with a hearing within four weeks thereafter.

not_decided.point: Legality of the recovery certificate dated 29.09.2021
not_decided.note: The Court expressed no opinion on merits and left the objection to be decided by respondent no. 2.
